hooks.name: Keep inline scripts out of templates
hooks.description: After Kiro saves a Thymeleaf template, looks for inline script blocks, on* event-handler attributes (including th:on*) and javascript: links. The Content-Security-Policy (script-src 'self') blocks all of them, so they would fail silently in the browser.

action.command: hits=$( (grep -nHE "<script([[:space:]>]|$)" src/main/resources/templates/*.html | grep -v "src="; grep -nHE "([[:space:]]|th:)on[a-z]+=|javascript:" src/main/resources/templates/*.html) 2>/dev/null ); [ -z "$hits" ] && exit 0; printf "The CSP (script-src self) blocks inline scripts, on* handlers and javascript: links; move this code to src/main/resources/static/js:\n%s\n" "$hits" >&2; exit 1
